definitions.failure: 3 consecutive known frames IoU<.2; recovery3 known frames IoU>=.5
definitions.candidate_recall: IoU>=.5 among valid actual proposals; original5 vs original plus executed extra5, same pre-action state
definitions.harm_rescue: same-state frozen C1 selection versus chosen current box; not independent future-rollout causality
definitions.memory_mass: target slot EMA localization provenance and selected maximum-support source; normalized feature purity not asserted
definitions.template_pollution: actual pre-frame template source localization; unknownGT excluded; no semantic distractor labels
definitions.state_commit_geometry: When selective-state fields exist: committed same-frame search reference and motion observation versus actual GT. Localization proxies, unknownGT excluded; correct active-template source does not imply no earlier wrong writes or causal recovery benefit.
definitions.motion: frozen bootstrap motion forecast, sensor-specific labels; not new motion model training
definitions.timing: instrumented tracking including decode/crop/update; concurrent-load comparisons descriptive
